description: Commission of Election - Filling of an MP vacancy in the Parliament. (Mr.Bandula Lal bandarigoda)
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the filling of a parliamentary vacancy resulting from an electoral process. It specifically deals with the declaration of an elected Member of Parliament to fill a seat vacated due to the dismissal of an expulsion petition by the Supreme Court. The content focuses on electoral procedures, candidate declarations, and parliamentary membership - all core elements of election-related administrative matters, making it clearly fall under the Elections category.
